# Fastex Media

> Fastex Media is a marketing consulting firm for B2B companies, startups and
> growth-stage businesses. We architect revenue systems: we design the strategy,
> build the pipeline and run the machine. Working with ambitious businesses
> worldwide.

Founded June 2025 by Aagam Shah (Founder). B2B only. We do not run
direct-to-consumer or e-commerce campaigns. We report on qualified meetings
booked and pipeline created rather than impressions or lead counts.

Every engagement starts with a free 30 minute strategy session. Scope and price
are discussed on that call and are not published, because they depend on ICP,
deal size and target volume.

Contact: hello@fastexmedia.com

## What a revenue architecture firm is

A revenue architecture firm designs the system a company uses to generate and
convert demand, then builds and operates it. It differs from a marketing agency
in scope and accountability: an agency is engaged to execute activity inside one
channel and is measured on delivering that activity, while an architecture
partner decides which channels should exist, how they feed each other, and how
results are measured against closed revenue.

## The Architecture Suite

Three systems, run together.

### Pipeline, creating demand and booking meetings

- [LinkedIn Outreach](https://www.fastexmedia.com/services/linkedin-outreach/): Outbound to named decision makers, researched, sequenced and booked straight into your sales calendar. 30+ qualified conversations a month.
- [WhatsApp Marketing](https://www.fastexmedia.com/services/whatsapp-marketing/): Official WhatsApp Business API journeys for B2B enquiry response, distributor networks and pipeline follow-up.
- [Cold Email Marketing](https://www.fastexmedia.com/services/email-marketing/): Cold outbound infrastructure built on deliverability, with research led sequences that earn replies from senior buyers.

### Authority, being the obvious shortlist choice

- [Personal Branding](https://www.fastexmedia.com/services/personal-branding/): Founder and executive authority, because in B2B people buy from the person before they buy from the company.
- [UGC Videos](https://www.fastexmedia.com/services/ugc-videos/): Customer testimonial video, operator walkthroughs and case study film that remove buying hesitation.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.fastexmedia.com/services/social-media-marketing/): Organic presence that makes your company the obvious choice when a business buyer starts shortlisting vendors.

### Performance, converting intent efficiently

- [Performance Marketing](https://www.fastexmedia.com/services/performance-marketing/): Paid acquisition on LinkedIn, Google and Meta measured against cost per qualified meeting, not clicks.

## Who we work with

- [Founders](https://www.fastexmedia.com/for-founders/): Early stage. You have the product, you need the first repeatable revenue system.
- [Builders](https://www.fastexmedia.com/for-builders/): Growth stage. The model works, the first channel has plateaued.
- [Enterprises](https://www.fastexmedia.com/for-enterprises/): Established. You need an embedded partner who owns the number, not another vendor.

## Industries

- [IT & Software](https://www.fastexmedia.com/industries/it-software/): B2B pipeline for IT and software companies. Qualified meetings with CTOs, IT directors and technical buyers through cold email, LinkedIn and paid demand.
- [Solar & Renewable Energy](https://www.fastexmedia.com/industries/solar-renewable/): Commercial solar pipeline for EPCs and renewable energy providers. Meetings with facility managers, plant heads and finance leads for high-ticket projects.
- [Manufacturing](https://www.fastexmedia.com/industries/manufacturing/): B2B pipeline for manufacturers and exporters. Conversations with procurement heads, sourcing managers and distributors, beyond trade shows and referrals.
- [Educational Institutes](https://www.fastexmedia.com/industries/education/): B2B marketing for universities, school groups and EdTech. Corporate partnerships, institutional tie-ups and qualified enquiry systems.
- [Real Estate](https://www.fastexmedia.com/industries/real-estate/): B2B pipeline for commercial real estate. Corporate tenants, channel partners and investors for developers and brokerages, beyond portal leads.
